title: 第六章 第一批封测玩家
content_zh:
“我是NPC。”
对着镜子这么说了一句，楚光深深吸了口气，整了整自己的衣领，努力让自己的形象看起来足够威严。
且面无表情。
距离那天已经过去了三天。
再过几分钟，就到玩家们登陆游戏的时间了。
至于他身上的这件蓝外套，是很久以前刚穿越到这个世界时，身上穿着的那套。
贝特街的老查理曾和他说过，从避难所里出来的居民，似乎都穿这个。
“我是一名NPC。”
楚光对着从外面捡来的镜子，再次练习了一遍。
这份“新工作”的性质，和他之前从事的那份销售工作可以说是完全迥异，如沐春风的笑容和彬彬有礼的态度，无论如何也不应该出现在一名管理者的身上。
毕竟，这里可是奉行丛林法则的废土。
能在这片废土上生存下来，他的形象不一定得是一名铁血硬汉，但至少得给人足够的信心和安全感。
摸了摸自己脸颊的线条，楚光在心中思忖，自己是不是应该在额头上弄条刀疤？
或者干脆把头发整成朋克风的莫西干头？
毕竟这里可是奉行丛林法则的废土。
会影响代入感。
“主人。”
扔对着镜子扣造型的楚光，面无表情地抬了抬下巴。
“怎么了？”
小柒小声说道。

“根据我查阅到的资料，游戏中的NPC通常是不会称自己为NPC的。”
脸上的表情略微一滞，楚光轻咳了声说道。
“我当然知道……”
对着镜子，他重新嘀咕了一句。
“……我是404号避难所的管理者。”
话说差不多也该到约定的时间了。
三个小时前，培养舱就已经完成了克隆体的合成。
而之前他在企鹅上和四名拿到封测资格的“幸运儿”也约好了，燕京时间晚上九点之前戴上头盔，找个舒服的姿势平躺或者横卧，九点钟一到准时登陆游戏。
就在楚光思索着该以什么样的姿态在玩家们面前登场的时候，脑海中忽然响起了“叮”的一声。
紧接着，一行文字浮现在了他的面前。
【任务完成！】
楚光心中微微一紧。
“草草草草！绝了！”
居民大厅隔壁的生活区，一间其貌不扬的房间里，四台培养舱同时解除锁定，开启了半透明的舱门。
从敞开的培养舱中坐起，叶炜目瞪口呆，环顾四周，脸上写满了诧异，甚至于呆滞。
就是游戏世界？！
直到一分钟前，他还在心里嘀咕着，这有没有可能是一个精心策划的恶作剧。
然而就在他戴着充满电的头盔，平躺在床上，就快要睡着的时候，一道光却是穿破了黑暗向他射来。
当他再次睁开眼，已经身处于一个陌生的房间。
身上湿糊糊的。

就好像刚从池子里捞出来。
头顶排风口吹出的风落在肩上，能明显的感觉到液体正在一点点被蒸干，带走了身上的热量。
这其中还隐隐伴随着一股不太好闻的气味儿。
叶炜猛然惊觉，瞪大双眼。
五感俱全！
牛逼！！！
这身临其境的体感，让他的眼眶忍不住盈满了泪水。
没想到在有生之年，居然真的能见到完全沉浸式的虚拟现实技术！
这已经不能用碉堡来形容了！
不只是他一个人。
其他三名从培养舱中坐起的玩家，脸上也纷纷露出了不约而同的震撼。
“我擦，我擦我擦我擦。”
“……我特么还以为是开玩笑。”
“妈耶！还真特么是完全沉浸！”
“现在的科技已经这么发达了么？？？歪日，老子咋从来没在新闻上见过？！”
“嘶……痛觉都特么有。”一名玩家掐了一下自己。
“你丫的是谁？NPC？”
“鬼的NPC，我是老白啊！白驹过隙！你这家伙又是谁？”
“卧槽？老细？！我是狂风啊！八级大狂风！你咋长这样？哈哈哈哈，笑死爹。”
“滚！再特么叫我老细，老子就让你知道啥叫老粗……嘿，这游戏有点意思，外貌已经设定好了？不知道公测版本能不能捏人。”

老白也掐了自己一把，虽然疼的龇牙咧嘴，但脸上却写满了高兴。
难以置信！
梦想照进了现实！
隔壁床位的叶炜，瞪着两只眼睛，一动不动，努力消化着心中的震撼。
除了他，还有一个伙计坐着没动，应该是群里的来日方长。
只见这家伙正盯着自己的两腿之间沉思，不知道是在思考着什么。
“角色设定默认是男性角色？居然没有捏人的环节。我的意思是……能不能建个女号？”
“草，你特么好骚啊！你这家伙肯定是夜十。”
“我是方长……”
“卧槽？！方长？！好兄弟……你懂我意思吧？”
“滚，我就是随口一说。旁边这位兄弟是夜十吧……你们都来了？”
见三人看向了自己，叶炜总算是回过神来。
意识到自己还光着，他连忙拿起培养舱边挂着的制服套在头上，随口应了一句说道。
“嗯，刚到……这游戏咋玩的？没新手教程吗？”
“不知道，我们也刚来。”
话音刚落，房间的门
一位穿着蓝色外套的男人，从外面走了进来。
他的身后跟着一台废纸篓形状的机器人，筒子一样的身型看起来有些憨态可掬，但流线型的外壳和仿佛抛光过的银漆却充满了科幻感。
四名玩家的眼睛都看直了。
“NPC！”

“和真人一模一样！”
“这里真的是游戏世界吗？”
“这也太真实了叭！”
“安静，”打断了那叽叽喳喳的吵闹，楚光环视了房间内的四名玩家一眼，缓缓开口说道，“欢迎来到404号避难所。”
“我是这里的管理者。”
“代号——曙光。”
空气一瞬间的寂静。
四名玩家出乎意料的老实，屏息凝视地盯着他，深怕错漏了任何一处剧情细节。
看来自己的气势已经成功控场。
楚光心中松了口气，按照准备好的剧本，继续说道。
“首先我得告诉你们一件好消息，战争已经结束了。”
“但坏消息是，我们的世界已经面目全非，如果你们指望马上拎着行李回家找妈妈，显然不太可能。”
“现在是末日之后的第两百个年头，值得庆幸的是我们已经成功熬过了最艰难的年月。你们能站在里，已经比120亿人更幸运，而现在我需要你们尽快认清现状，然后履行自己在人联旗帜下的宣言——重建我们的家园！”
“旁边这位是我的助手，它名字叫小柒，有任何关于避难所的问题，或者不明白的地方都可以问它。”
以上是开场白。
下一批玩家来了，楚光会再说一遍。
毕竟是好不容易编出来的。
而小柒这边，哪些能说，哪些不能说，楚光已经事先知会它了，倒也不用担心说漏嘴的问题。
其实就算说漏嘴了也没事儿。
任何解释不了的地方，都能用一句“这是游戏设定”搪塞过去。这年头哪有完美无缺的设定，非要较真儿的话，新闻联播都能找出BUG。

见楚光终于说完，那个登记昵称叫夜十的玩家，连忙开口问道。
“请问光哥在哪？我的意思是，给我们头盔的那位游戏策划。”
“我听不懂你在说什么。”楚光面无表情的回答。
“如何登出游戏？”老白接上话。
“回到培养舱内躺下，可以正常登出。”
其实还有一种方法，昏迷、睡眠、死亡等异常状态也会导致连接中断，但楚光并不希望他们随意尝试。
躺在培养舱里比较节能，随地躺尸处理起来会很麻烦。
“等级呢？玩家系统的界面在哪里？我怎么找不到？”
狂风刚将这句话问出口，楚光还没来得及作答，旁边的方长便紧跟着插嘴问道。
“捏人系统呢？角色设定不可更改吗？还有角色性别方面——”
“够了，这些问题你们去问策……咳，现在还没有轮到你们提问。”
满头黑线地打断了这些人没完没了的问题，楚光板着脸，用公事公办的态度，将四本小册子，不由分说地甩到了他们手中。
“我会带你们熟悉一下这里的环境，同时告诉你们需要注意的事项。”
“尤其是什么事情能做，什么事情想都别想。”
（感谢“ε伊蕾娜з”、“来自未来的卡卡罗特”的盟主打赏~~~~~）
content_en:
"I am an NPC."
After saying this to the mirror, Chu Guang took a deep breath, adjusted his collar, and tried to make his image look majestic enough.
And his face was expressionless.
Three days have passed since that day.
In a few minutes, it will be time for players to log into the game.
As for the blue coat he is wearing, it is the one he wore when he first traveled to this world a long time ago.
Old Charlie from Bate Street once told him that all the residents who came out of the shelter seemed to be wearing this.
"I am an NPC."
Chu Guang practiced again in front of the mirror he picked up from outside.
The nature of this "new job" can be said to be completely different from the sales job he held before. A spring-like smile and a polite attitude should not appear in a manager anyway.
After all, this is a wasteland governed by the laws of the jungle.
To survive in this wasteland, his image does not necessarily have to be that of a tough guy, but at least he must give people enough confidence and security.
Touching the lines of his cheek, Chu Guang thought in his heart, should he get a scar on his forehead?
Or maybe just style your hair into a punk-style mohawk?
After all, this is a wasteland that follows the laws of the jungle.
It will affect the sense of substitution.
"Master."
Chu Guang, who looked at the button in the mirror, raised his chin expressionlessly.
"What's wrong?"
Xiao Qi whispered.
"According to the information I've read, NPCs in games usually don't call themselves NPCs."
The expression on his face was slightly stagnant, Chu Guang coughed lightly and said.
"Of course I know..."
Looking in the mirror, he muttered again.
"...I am the manager of Vault 404."
By the way, it’s almost time to arrive at the appointed time.
Three hours ago, the culture chamber had completed the synthesis of clones.
Previously, he had made an appointment with the four "lucky people" who had qualified for the closed beta test on Penguin. They would put on their helmets before nine o'clock in the evening Beijing time, find a comfortable position to lie flat or horizontally, and log in to the game on time at nine o'clock.
Just when Chu Guang was thinking about how he should appear in front of the players, a "ding" suddenly sounded in his mind.
Then, a line of text appeared in front of him.
【Mission completed! 】
Chu Guang's heart tightened slightly.
"Hahahahahaha! Absolutely!"
In the living area next to the residents' hall, in an unattractive room, four cultivation cabins were unlocked at the same time and the translucent hatches were opened.
Sitting up from the open training cabin, Ye Wei was stunned and looked around, his face full of surprise, even sluggishness.
Is it the game world? !
Until a minute ago, he had been wondering to himself whether this might be an elaborate prank.
However, just when he was lying on the bed wearing a fully charged helmet and about to fall asleep, a ray of light broke through the darkness and shot towards him.
When he opened his eyes again, he was already in a strange room.
My body was wet.
It's like being fished out of the pond.
The wind blowing from the air vent above your head fell on your shoulders, and you could clearly feel that the liquid was being evaporated bit by bit, taking away the heat from your body.
There was also a faint smell that wasn't pleasant.
Ye Wei suddenly woke up and his eyes widened.
All five senses!
Awesome! ! !
This immersive experience made his eyes filled with tears.
I never expected that I would actually see fully immersive virtual reality technology in my lifetime!
This can no longer be described as a bunker!
It's not just him.
The other three players who sat up from the training cabin also showed the same shock on their faces.
"I wipe, I wipe, I wipe, I wipe."
"...I really thought it was a joke."
"Oh my god! It's really special.What a total immersion! "
“Is technology already so advanced now? ? ? Damn it, why have I never seen it on the news? ! "
"Hiss...it hurts so much. "One player pinched himself.
"Who are you? NPC? "
"Damn NPC, I am Lao Bai! Time flies! Who are you? "
"What the hell? Boss? ! I am the strong wind! Level 8 strong wind! Why do you look like this? Hahahaha, laugh to death. "
"roll! If you call me a boss again, I'll let you know what a rough guy is... Hey, this game is interesting. The appearance has been set? I don’t know if the public beta version can pinch people. "
Lao Bai also pinched himself. Although he grimaced in pain, his face was full of happiness.
Unbelievable!
Dreams come true!
Ye Wei, who was in the bed next door, stared motionless, trying to digest the shock in his heart.
Besides him, there was another guy who was sitting still. He must have been in the group for a long time.
I saw this guy staring at his legs in deep thought, wondering what he was thinking about.
“The character setting is male by default? There is actually no pinching part. I mean...can you create a female account? "
"Fuck, you're so naughty! You must be Ye Shi. "
"I am Fang Chang..."
"What the hell? ! Square and long? ! Good brother...you know what I mean, right? "
"Go away, I just said it casually. The brother next to you is Ye Shi, right? Are you all here? "
Seeing the three people looking at him, Ye Wei finally came back to his senses.
Realizing that he was still naked, he quickly picked up the uniform hanging by the training cabin and put it on his head, and said casually.
"Well, I just arrived...how do you play this game? No tutorial for beginners? "
"I don't know, we just arrived. "
As soon as he finished speaking, the door of the room
A man in a blue coat walked in from outside.
Behind him was a wastebasket-shaped robot. The tube-like body looked a bit naive, but the streamlined shell and polished silver paint were full of science fiction.
The eyes of the four players all looked straight.
"NPC! "
"Exactly like a real person! "
"Is this really a game world? "
"This is too true! "
"Quiet," interrupting the chatter, Chu Guang glanced at the four players in the room and said slowly, "Welcome to Shelter No. 404. "
"I'm the manager here. "
"Code name - Dawn. "
The air was silent for a moment.
The four players were surprisingly honest and stared at him with bated breath, fearing that they would miss any plot details.
It seems that his momentum has been successfully controlled.
Chu Guang felt relieved and continued according to the prepared script.
"First of all, I have to tell you some good news. The war is over. "
"But the bad news is that our world has changed beyond recognition, and if you expect to pick up your luggage and go home to your mother right away, it's obviously not possible. "
“We are now in the 200th year after the end of the world, and thankfully we have successfully survived the most difficult years. You are luckier than 12 billion people to be standing here, and now I need you to recognize the current situation as soon as possible, and then fulfill your declaration under the banner of the People's Federation - to rebuild our home! "
"This is my assistant next to me. Its name is Xiao Qi. If you have any questions about the shelter or anything you don't understand, you can ask it. "
The above is the opening statement.
When the next batch of players comes, Chu Guang will say it again.
After all, it was made up with great difficulty.
As for Xiao Qi, Chu Guang has already known in advance what can and cannot be said, so he doesn't have to worry about letting it slip.
In fact, it's okay even if I spill the beans.
If you can't explain anything, you can just say "this is the game setting"Prevaricate. There is no such thing as a perfect setting these days. If you really want to be honest, Xinwen Lianbo can find bugs.
Seeing that Chu Guang had finally finished speaking, the player whose registered nickname was Ye Shi quickly asked.
"Where is Brother Guang? I mean, the game planner who gave us the helmets."
"I don't understand what you are talking about." Chu Guang replied expressionlessly.
"How to log out of the game?" Lao Bai answered.
"Go back to the training cabin and lie down. You can log out normally."
In fact, there is another method. Abnormal states such as coma, sleep, and death can also cause connection interruption, but Chu Guang does not want them to try it casually.
Lying in the culture chamber is more energy-saving, but it will be troublesome to dispose of corpses lying anywhere.
"Where is the level? Where is the interface for the player system? Why can't I find it?"
As soon as Kuangfeng asked this question, before Chu Guang had time to answer, Fang Chang next to him interrupted and asked.
"What about the pinch system? Is the character setting unchangeable? And the gender of the character -"
"That's enough, you can ask these questions... Well, it's not your turn to ask questions yet."
With a head full of black lines, Chu Guang interrupted these people's endless questions. With a straight face and a business-like attitude, Chu Guang threw the four pamphlets into their hands without any explanation.
"I will take you to familiarize yourself with the environment here and tell you what you need to pay attention to."
"Especially if you can do anything, don't even think about anything."
(Thanks to the leaders of "ε Irenaз" and "Kakarot from the Future" for the reward~~~~~)
